# GitHub Repository Topics

Add the following topics to the repository via the GitHub UI.

Go to: https://github.com/Kakaxh1/RootRaven > About (gear icon) > Topics

Paste these one by one:

android-security
android-pentesting
ios-pentesting
mobile-security
frida
frida-android
frida-hooking
adb
ssl-pinning-bypass
apk-decompiler
jadx
burp-suite
mobile-pentest
dynamic-analysis
security-research
python
flask
red-team
objection
android-hacking

These topics make the repository appear in GitHub Explore and GitHub topic search pages,
which are indexed by Google Search.
